description.zh: 自定义评分维度列表（仅 qwen-custom-correction-v1 模型支持）
description.en: A list of custom scoring dimensions. This parameter is supported only by the `qwen-custom-correction-v1` model.
The maximum score for the dimension.
The scoring rubric for the dimension.

description.zh: 年级（公共值，优先取子任务中的grade）
description.en: A default grade to apply to all tasks. If a `grade` is also specified within an individual task, the task-level value takes precedence.

description.zh: 其他评阅要点（公共值，优先取子任务中的otherReviewPoints ）
description.en: Default additional review criteria to apply to all tasks. If `otherReviewPoints` is also specified within an individual task, the task-level value takes precedence.

description.zh: 作文题目（公共值，优先取子任务中的question）
description.en: A default essay topic to apply to all tasks. If a `question` is also specified within an individual task, the task-level value takes precedence.

description.zh: 科目（公共值，优先取子任务中的subject）
description.en: A default subject to apply to all tasks. If a `subject` is also specified within an individual task, the task-level value takes precedence.
The student's response to the essay topic.

description.zh: 用户自定义ID。用来唯一标识每个任务，不能重复
description.en: A custom ID that uniquely identifies the task.

description.zh:
年级，可选值有：
[
        "初中一年级",
        "初中二年级",
        "初中三年级",
        "高中一年级",
        "高中二年级",
        "高中三年级"
]
description.en:
The grade. Valid values are:
\[
"Junior High Grade 1",
"Junior High Grade 2",
"Junior High Grade 3",
"Senior High Grade 1",
"Senior High Grade 2",
"Senior High Grade 3"
]

description.zh:
科目，可选值有：[
        "语文",
        "英语应用文",
        "英语读后续写"
      ]
description.en:
The subject. Valid values are: \[
"Chinese",
"English Applied Writing",
"English Read and Continue Writing"
]
The maximum possible score for the essay.

description.zh: 总分（公共值，优先取子任务中的 totalScore）
description.en: A default total score to apply to all tasks. If a `totalScore` is also specified within an individual task, the task-level value takes precedence.
